title: How a trash can lid works

facts.intro: A spring pushes the latch bolt upward, keeping the lid sealed.
facts.reveal: When you press the tab, the handle pivots and pulls the bolt down against the spring.
facts.step1: The bolt slides out of its catch, unlocking the lid.
facts.step2: The lid lifts freely as you raise the press tab.
facts.step3: When you let go, the spring pulls the handle back.
facts.step4: The handle pushes the bolt back into the catch, relocking the lid.
facts.hold: The spring remains compressed, ready to snap the bolt shut again.
facts.payoff: The lid snaps shut automatically, keeping odors contained.
